chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Wash your garment from the urine of everything whose flesh is not eaten.
ai.seo_question: How to purify clothes from the urine of animals with edible meat according to Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this concise ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishing the general principle that urine from non-human animals is ritually impure (*najasah*) requiring washing for valid prayer. This hadith serves as a foundational text in Shia fiqh for distinguishing between the urine of humans, which is pure, and that of other creatures, reinforcing the necessity of physical cleanliness (*taharah*) as a prerequisite for the validity of *Salat*.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Wash your clothes from urine of everything the flesh of which cannot be eaten’.
en.sarwar: 12. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Wash your clothes clean because of urine of all inedible animals.’”
